how: We read the website of every San Antonio wedding florist listed on Lazo (132 listings, 106 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops and funeral florists, a landscape nursery, venues and an elopement officiant the category lists, and a faux-floral rental whose site text was about a makeup business. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What holds up in August heat for an outdoor ceremony, and what do you substitute when it will not?
Do you design and install at the venue, or deliver arrangements? Teardown is usually the line that changes the price.
Can I see a full wedding's florals at a budget like mine, not just a bouquet?

picks.name: Evember
picks.blurb: Evember Floral Design creates refined, artistic florals for weddings and events across San Antonio and the Hill Country, treating flowers as a language of celebration. Every bloom, texture and color is chosen to tell the couple's story, from intimate gatherings to grand celebrations.

picks.name: Botanika
picks.blurb: Botanika's founder traces the work back to age ten, rearranging the living room and assembling color combinations and textures. A San Antonio wedding and event florist that also lists wedding planning among its services, with a featured wedding and recent work on the site.

picks.name: Freesia Designs Events
picks.blurb: Freesia Designs is a full-service floral and event design company in San Antonio that works in the luxury market and describes its team as perfectionists and innovators. Highly customized weddings with what it calls fierce attention to detail and timeless, sophisticated design.

picks.name: Bluebonnet Fields Floral
picks.blurb: Bluebonnet Fields Floral designs exclusively for weddings and events, from bouquets and centerpieces to statement installations, serving San Antonio and Austin. The site introduces the designer as your flower BFF and keeps the focus on custom work for your style and theme.

picks.name: The Petal Artist
picks.blurb: Stephanie and Meritt call themselves The Petal Artists because they tell your story through flowers, from the walk out your parents' door to the first dance. Based in Spring Branch, they describe themselves as the whole package for a wedding's florals.

picks.name: South Texas Flower Company
picks.blurb: South Texas Flower Company is Rosa's luxury floral studio in San Antonio, grown from a childhood love of flowers and a first flower company in Eagle Pass. Wedding florals sit alongside seasonal wreaths and premium artificial arrangements, so ask which you are getting.

picks.name: Uptown Flowers
picks.blurb: William Garza and the Uptown Flowers design team bring over 30 years of floral design experience to events from a shop in San Antonio's historic Deco district on Fredericksburg Road. A retail florist with delivery that also pitches itself for unique, memorable occasions.

picks.name: Blissful Beginnings Creations & Events
picks.blurb: Brandi is the creative force behind Blissful Beginnings, combining a floral design background with years of event planning into a one-stop shop for weddings in San Antonio and Austin. Planning, decor and floral come from the same person, which keeps the look consistent.

picks.name: Flower Rent & Co
picks.blurb: Not fresh flowers, but worth knowing: Flower Rent & Co rents premium lifelike faux arrangements for weddings and celebrations across South and Central Texas, pitched as the arch that looks the same at the end of the night. Rental prices are listed on the site, from $139 for small pieces.
